verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents `output=md` and `output=html`, but these return the search results page itself. The markdown is explicitly the "same data as JSON", meaning the same snippets and links, and the HTML is the raw SERP page Google returned. Nothing in the evidence shows SerpApi fetching or extracting the full text of the result pages it links to. The markdown output is an adjacent feature, and the community-described approach of running your own crawler on SerpApi links is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.
